description:
What if you had to fight for the flag?

Make your bot compete against the others. The best one wins. 2 minute ticks reward the current rankings. More details in deliverable

Only the latest bot sent to the server will compete. If you submit a bad bot, you can lose positions. You can submit once every 30 seconds. You don't need to re-submit the same bot, it will keep competing

name: Capture the Flag?
scoring_note: King of the Hill, scored continuously on 2-minute ticks and normalised against the leading team. Worth 20 percent of the event total; the jeopardy board is the other 80 percent.
why_this_mattered: Ranks 38, 39, 40, 41 and 43 all finished on an IDENTICAL jeopardy score of 2873, ours included. The jeopardy board saturated at that value, so King of the Hill was the only term separating those five teams, and it ordered them exactly: 142.2, 137.3, 133.8, 120.4, 83.3. The KOTH effort is therefore worth four places, measurably.
